title.en: Fable 7 — The Dove and the Ant

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A small ant went down to the river to drink.

sentences.ar: המים היו מהירים והיא נפלה פנימה.
sentences.en: The water was fast and she fell in.
She tried to get out and did not succeed.
The water took her further and further.

sentences.ar: יונה ישבה על ענף מעל הנהר.
sentences.en: A dove sat on a branch above the river.
She saw the ant in the water.

sentences.ar: היא לקחה עלה וזרקה אותו למטה.
sentences.en: She took a leaf and threw it down.

sentences.ar: הנמלה עלתה על העלה והחזיקה חזק.
sentences.en: The ant climbed on the leaf and held tight.
The leaf reached the shore, and the ant came out.

sentences.ar: אחרי כמה ימים בא צייד ליער.
sentences.en: After a few days a hunter came to the forest.

sentences.ar: הוא ראה את היונה על העץ.
sentences.en: He saw the dove on the tree.

sentences.ar: הוא הרים את הרובה שלו לאט.

sentences.en: The ant saw him from the ground.

sentences.ar: היא רצה מהר ועלתה על הרגל שלו.
sentences.en: She ran fast and climbed on his foot.
The hunter shouted and moved his foot.
The dove heard and flew away from there at once.
A small kindness returns on a hard day.
